title: BetterLapras
description: Cobblemon addon that enhance Lapras AI to be able to use moves in the overworld!
body:
This is an addon for Cobblemon that makes Lapras as good as it should be!

Adds:
- Lapras will target any hostile/aggroed mobs by using a move (Determined by first slot)
- GMax Lapras model added (Mega Showdown required)
- Perish Song
- Series of /lapras commands which are able to scan inventories for egg info such as Shiny or IV scans (Cobbreeding required)
